title: QUIC RFC 9000 Weakly Protected Packet Failure Policy Work Item
summary: Close the remaining S5P2 weak-protection tail by proving packet-protection open failures are discarded and weakly protected invalid payloads generate PROTOCOL_VIOLATION without retaining partial content-processing side effects.
planned_changes:
- Add shared S5P2 packet-protection test helpers.
- Add focused tests for Initial and Handshake packet open failure discard with keys available.
- Add focused tests for forbidden weakly protected payload frames after valid prefixes generating PROTOCOL_VIOLATION.
- Pre-validate Initial and Handshake payloads before mutating TLS crypto buffers or transcript state.
- Add focused architecture and verification artifacts and regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S5P2 tail requirement-home filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: Broad packet-protection cryptographic correctness beyond runtime failure handling.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused runtime failure-policy proof for REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0010, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0012, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S5P2-0013.
